keyEvents.text: Goal! Heerenveen 0, Feyenoord 1. Anis Hadj Moussa (Feyenoord) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Nacho Ferri.
Goal! Heerenveen 0, Feyenoord 2. Nacho Ferri (Feyenoord) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Heerenveen 1, Feyenoord 2. Maas Willemsen (Heerenveen) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal following a corner.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Ringo Meerveld replaces Maxence Rivera.
Goal! Heerenveen 2, Feyenoord 2. Levi Smans (Heerenveen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Marcus Linday.
Goal! Heerenveen 3, Feyenoord 2. Ringo Meerveld (Heerenveen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Sem Steijn replaces Oussama Targhalline.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Thijs Kraaijeveld replaces Tsuyoshi Watanabe.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Jerayno Schaken replaces Luciano Valente.
Levi Smans (Heerenveen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Heerenveen 3, Feyenoord 3. Sem Steijn (Feyenoord) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Nacho Ferri with a headed pass.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Shaqueel van Persie replaces Nacho Ferri.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Mats Egbring replaces Vasilios Zagaritis because of an injury.
Goal! Heerenveen 4, Feyenoord 3. Ringo Meerveld (Heerenveen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jacob Trenskow.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Mees Hilgers replaces Sam Kersten.
